## Answer

## How I obtained it

I read the `invoices.csv` file from the working directory. The file contains a CSV table with the following columns:
- id (invoice ID)
- customer (customer name)
- amount (invoice amount)
- status (payment status)

I searched through the data and found the entry for INV-1019 on line 21 of the file:
```
INV-1019,Delta Foods,956,paid
```

This shows that invoice INV-1019 belongs to **Delta Foods**, with an invoice amount of 956 and a payment status of "paid".
